tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

cover_en.subject: Application: [Post] Dimpal G.
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in joining your team. With over 5 years of professional experience specializing in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) development at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, Spring, and enterprise e-commerce solutions.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce & Java
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing and customer data management.

bullets.label: REST APIs & Headless
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and built RESTful APIs for Headless Commerce integrations and PWA frontends.

bullets.label: Integrations & Data
bullets.text: Designed, built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub to keep product catalogs synchronized.

bullets.label: Database & DevOps
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2).

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe and hold a valid German residence and work permit with no sponsorship required. I am currently serving my notice period with a last working day on 15 December 2026, and I will be available to start on 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my backend and e-commerce background aligns with your needs.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to contribute my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud and Java backend expertise to your dynamic projects. My experience building robust e-commerce architectures, managing complex integrations, and optimizing system performance at companies like Rockwell Automation and Shell makes me well-prepared to add immediate value to your engineering initiatives.
tailoring.motivation_short: Leveraging 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud and Java expertise to build scalable e-commerce solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience in Java, Spring, and enterprise e-commerce platforms. I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid work permit, and am available from 16.12.2026. I would love to connect and discuss potential opportunities.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for [Post] Dimpal G. - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the [Post] Dimpal G. role. With over 5 years of hands-on experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms using SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, and Spring at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-equipped to contribute to your team. I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and am available to start on 16.12.2026 following my notice period. I look forward to discussing my application with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
